title: /login opens with what Tracy is beside the sign-in card, Google first, links to tracy.ai, Discord and X, and a hint for a mistyped big-mailbox domain
steps: S1: loginPage for every interface language with Google configured.
S2: loginPage with Google only, with Google and GitHub, and with no provider.
S3: loginPage at the code step.

S4: The page script in jsdom: blur the address field with 'person@gmail.con', 'person@gmial.com', 'person@hotmial.com', then press the hint; then with 'person@hotmail.fr', 'person@gmx.at', 'person@lrv.de'.
expect: S1: .signin-title is login.pitchTitle, .signin-eyebrow is login.heroTitle, the card title is login.getStarted, the submit button is login.emailMeCode, in each language.
S2: the Google form precedes #email-form; a GitHub form only when GitHub is configured; no .providers and no separator without a provider.
S4: #email-suggest shown with the fixed address in <strong>; pressing it fills the field and hides the hint; no hint for the last three.

selectors.files: apps/tracy-web/src/identity/pages.js (loginPage, signInPitch, signInLinks, loginScript likelyAddress); apps/tracy-web/src/lib/public-links.js (LINKS)

evidence: Issue #33: most signed-out visits from campaign links left the first screen without starting to sign in; a gmail.con typo lost a sign-up
fence: The hint never changes the address unasked and never fires for a provider's own country domain or a company domain

tests: every interface language draws the pitch and the sign-in card in its own words
Google comes before the address form
the code step still hides the first card
a mistyped big-mailbox domain is offered back fixed
a real address, a provider’s own country domain and a company domain get no hint
